scripts.comment: Named 'compile', NOT 'build', on purpose: Vercel auto-runs a 'build' script and then expects a public/ output dir, which flips this static site into build-deploy mode and fails. 'compile' is local-only; the committed *.bundle.js and styles.css are what Vercel serves.
scripts.compile: node build.mjs && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i src/input.css -o styles.css --minify
